page_purpose: Present Retro Ad as a complete RetroVerse 1978 ad page page, with page-aware artwork under real typography and no text baked into the illustration layer for `retro_ad`.
page_intent_readback: Present Retro Ad as a complete RetroVerse 1978 ad page page, with page-aware artwork under real typography and no text baked into the illustration layer for `retro_ad`.
composition_type: full-page editorial support illustration with disciplined copy zones

art_zone_dimensions.purpose: Background illustration layer beneath final layout typography.

color_palette: cinema red, projector gold, chrome, and warm paper stock
scene_description: A single faux-product tableau from 1978, styled as scene artwork rather than a full magazine ad layout.
visual_hierarchy: Primary focal area supports Retro Ad.
Secondary props reinforce `retro_ad` without competing with text zones.
Negative space stays calm inside title, body, sidebar, and footer zones.
Decorative elements remain subordinate to the primary text frame.
optional_easter_egg_guidance: Optional and subtle only: a tiny RetroVerse Easter egg may appear as environmental detail, but it must never behave like final page typography.
studio_role_responsibility: Handle small decorative, utility, and department pages with compact scene motifs that support layout without overwhelming copy.
studio_style_rules: Favor simple props, vignettes, and atmospheric details over large cinematic action.
Keep ornamentation modular so the layout engine can place typography cleanly on top.
Treat the page as editorial support art, not a simulated finished advertisement or magazine spread.
text_rendering_instruction: DO NOT RENDER FINAL TEXT INTO THE ARTWORK
